checks.command: pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run test && pnpm --dir apps/app-field/runtime run typecheck
checks.proves: Field runtime trust/readiness regressions are covered by the canonical candidate-bound gate.
checks.passCriteria: Field trust/readiness tests and typecheck pass on the same SHA.
checks.failCriteria: Missing test execution, trust/readiness failure or type error fails.

checks.command: RUNTIME: provision one field actor; test activation, valid login, wrong role/surface, missing or suspended Workforce profile, assignment revocation, restart and logout on the candidate.
checks.proves: End-to-end authorization/readiness across Identity, Workforce and app-field.
checks.passCriteria: Every negative case is denied explicitly and valid field identity remains isolated.
checks.failCriteria: Any stale/wrong-actor access, blank/fail-open state or session resurrection fails.
